copy_gaps: D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 put the word 'forming' in the legend, but §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no such word and §4.1's sketch (L218) shows none: the legend reads 'FP Bid × Ask · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (kit legend_text) and the cap alone marks 13:35 here. Carry for E18-D05 (to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): a legend '· forming' while the newest or cursor bar forms (D7 L157, §8.3 L763 against §4.9 L380-382); the boards draw it once settled.

Price-gutter labels (63,976.0-64,014.0, every 2 rows at E11-D02's 48 px gap) and the bar times (12:05-13:35, 5m) are derived from the window and the interval: the spec writes only 64,009.0-64,013.0 and 13:25 / 13:30 / 13:35 (§4.1 L220-227)
The pressed cluster segment reads 'Live' in E11-D02 §7.2 (L267; the word is owner question O-E, 'Live' or 'Following'), while §4.1's sketch writes 'auto' (L227): the board keeps 'auto'.
seed '20260928' (the bench CLI default) and cellsPerBar 40: §3 L172 names the generator but no seed; its default is 25 cells per bar
live_checks: No inst nodes: every control, chip, the legend, the axes and the cluster are compositions (kit DEVIATIONS compose), so there is no set, variant or text layer to verify.

After the last section: 19 'bar HH:MM' columns at x = i × 128.3 in the plot; 725 'r<n>' cell texts (2 of them '…'); the plot's first layer 'cell borders (Box)': 19 'borders HH:MM' boxes in 9 bands (706 level rules); 243 'o<row><side>' outlines, 5 brackets, 19 POC rail pairs, 38 VA ticks; one 'forming cap' and two ledges, on 13:35 only; the time labels under their columns.

Pressed controls: [FP], Chart and the cluster's auto each lead with the 16 px `check` glyph in ink before the label, on the selected fill (3 check glyphs); the cluster's third segment is the chevron-right glyph, no '>' text. The cluster (114.5 px: segments 50.5, 32, 32 px, 32 px high) sits at x 2433.5, y 0 (was x 2484.7), 8.4 px clear of the '13:35' label: check nothing overlaps and each label is centred.

Box borders: 'cell borders (Box)' must stay the plot's first child (under the columns); 1 px light-grey rules at fractional y (32.8 px rows), each column's frame an inner 1 px stroke over its cells' x-range: check each draws as one hairline, lines up with its column's cells and none shows through an outline.

13:35's marks: the cap at y 29.8 (1 px above 64,013.0's top edge at y 32.8), the high ledge at y 25.8, the low ledge at y 198.8 (2 px under 64,009.0's bottom edge): check they read as separate 2 px marks above and below the column.
cell digits: auto-width texts at a computed x (JetBrains Mono 0.6 em): check each side's digits share a right edge and the × column lines up; ▲ / ▼ must come from JetBrains Mono
rename frame 'SCR-030∕fp-anatomy' to 'SCR-030/fp-anatomy' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-030 / fp-anatomy')
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: 13:35 trades five levels, not 40: §3 L193's 'every row traded' is an upper bound, and the forming bar has traded §4.1's five levels 64,009.0–64,013.0 so far (L220-224), as boards 20, 21, 22, 23, 26 and 28 draw it; so the frame draws 725 of §3 L189's 760 cells, 13:35's POC is §4.1's 64,011.0 (L222; §4.7 L329, L349; §8.1 L731) and its cap and ledges draw. 13:25 and 13:30 carry §4.1's cells and bodies at 64,009.0–64,013.0 over the generator's other 35 rows (§4.1 L235 with §3 L172).

Two cells read '…' (13:25 and 13:30 at 64,009.0): §4.1 L224's '...' elides them from its five-row excerpt, but a '…' inside a cell shows something no footprint renders (build notes: each cell with the values its mode shows, §4.2). The generator's values cannot stand in: 13:25's 62 × 147 would outline the 702 ask above it (702 / 62 = 11.32); 13:30's 186 × 50 would leave the sketch unflagged (201 / 186 = 1.08), but a generator value inside §4.1's hand-picked column is the carry's call. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): §4.1 L224 hand-picks the two cells so no sketch cell gains an outline (13:25: bid 235–2,105, ask ≤ 380 (under three times this board's 64,008.0 bid 127); 13:30: bid 68–602, ask ≤ 239 (under three times this board's 64,008.0 bid 80)), then the boards draw them.

The short label ×3 buy is not drawn: 34.3 px free beside the newest bar is less than its 39.6 px at type.num.sm (+ 2 px), and the row above the 13:35 stack carries digits (D5 L155; §4.4 L290-291); the full label belongs to the hover / focus / selection states, not this frame

Box's heat fill by colorScale (§4.3 L271) is not drawn: the fill is hi-fi colour (E18-D03; §0 L28-29). Its 'bordered cell per level' is drawn by gen_05's box_borders() (gen_17's helper; the kit's bar_column() draws Box at L0 as digits only, e18kit.py not edited): a 1 px light-grey frame around each bar's traded levels and a 1 px rule between levels (706 rules), drawn as the plot's first layer 'cell borders (Box)' (19 'borders HH:MM' boxes in 9 bands) so it lies under every column's outlines, rails and digits and each column still packs into one section; Box is the default display (§6.2 L509).

Pressed states carry a CMP-019 `check` glyph (size.icon, ink) before the label, the selected fill kept as reinforcement: [FP] (the glyph stands for the sketch's '*', §4.1 L215), Chart (E11-D04 D1 L114, L139: E11-D02 D8's selected fill + check glyph) and the cluster's auto (E11-D02 D8 L115, §7.2 L267: the glyph is the ≥ 3:1 state carrier, the fill decorative, L493-495); §5 L393 and §8.3 L771 ask a geometry or text carrier for every state. The kit's ctl() and time_strip() draw the fill alone, so gen_05 adds the glyph (e18kit.py not edited). Not drawn: E11-D04's color.border.strong reinforcement edge (not a wireframe grey) and the options' own glyphs icon/chart-candles and icon/table (registry request CR-D04-3; the words carry the options).

The time-strip cluster is E11-D02's: segments 32 × 32 at comfortable (§2 L93; §7.2 L267), labels centred, the cluster at y 0 and at the strip's right end by time_strip()'s formula (x 2433.5, 8.4 px clear of the '13:35' label: E11-D02's 8 px exclusion zone); the pressed auto segment keeps the 32 px height and widens to 50.5 px for its check glyph and word (E11-D02 L267: the auto label widens the cluster leftwards). The third segment is E11-D02's `›`, named "Latest", drawn as the CMP-019 chevron-right glyph; §4.1's ASCII sketch writes '>' (L227).

Local compositions carry '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)' names (build notes; DEVIATIONS compose): CMP-223 DrawingToolbar, CMP-188 PriceAxis, CMP-189 TimeAxis, CMP-003 SegmentedControl · Chart | Table and the CMP-189 + CMP-004 cluster (E11-D02 L78); the kit names them 'CMP-223 drawing rail', 'CMP-188 price gutter', 'CMP-189 time strip', 'Chart | Table (segmented)' and 'cluster auto | fit | >'.

The 40 rows span 63,975.0–64,014.0, one row above the kit's base window (63,974.0–64,013.0), as boards 20 and 28 place it: 13:35's high is 64,013.0 as §4.1 draws it (L220) and the empty row above it holds the cap (L219) and the high ledge; the generator's 40 cells fill each older bar's 40 rows (kit scene(top=64,014.0)), one row above where boards 20 and 28's scene puts them; §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candle bodies of the 16 generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the 40-row window; every bar but 13:35 spans the window (§3 L193: every row traded), so its wick runs top to bottom; 13:35's wick spans its five traded levels 64,009.0–64,013.0 and its body 64,011.0–64,013.0 is §4.1's, as are 13:25's and 13:30's (L220-224); the body is filled (its form is E12-D06's, D3 L153).

Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared, as §4.1 draws its column (L233 'the three outlined cells'; the sketch outlines no edge, L220-224). `24` §4.2 (L792) treats a neighbour outside the traded range as zero volume under zero_policy treat_as_min, a fixed default (spec §6.2 L535-537): 38 of the 38 edge sides here are non-zero (19 highs' bids, 19 lows' asks), so `24` would add 38 outlines (281, not 243), among them 13:35's '3' in 3 × 18 at 64,013.0, which §4.1 draws unflagged; 12:30 would gain a ×3 sell 64,012.0–64,014.9 stack; 13:35's ×3 buy 64,010.0–64,012.9 would become ×4 buy 64,009.0–64,012.9. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either an A-row to `24` §4.2 'edge levels are not compared' (what the boards draw), or the boards draw the 38 edge outlines here and §4.1 L233-235's count is amended.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).

A mark beyond the plot is not drawn (kit clip): the 18 older bars trade all 40 rows (§3 L193), so the unfinished-auction ledges 2 px beyond their highs (18 two-sided) and lows (18 two-sided) fall outside the 1,312 px pane (D6 L156; their words stay in the tooltip, drawer and mirror, §4.5 L307); 13:35's cap and both ledges sit inside the window and are drawn.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
